summary: Occupying an enviable position on the prestigious Osborne Road, within the heart of the ever sought-after suburb of Jesmond, this spacious and beautifully presented two-bedroom converted apartment offers an exceptional opportunity for both homeowners and investors alike.
description:
Currently tenanted, the property provides an attractive ready-made investment with an established rental income, whilst also offering a superb future home in one of Newcastle's most desirable residential locations. Boasting generous proportions, impressive high ceilings and elegant period features throughout, the apartment effortlessly combines timeless character with contemporary open-plan living. Set back from Osborne Road behind attractive walled boundaries with gated access, the property enjoys a peaceful and private setting whilst remaining just moments from the vibrant amenities that make Jesmond one of the North East's most desirable places to live. An excellent selection of independent cafés, award-winning restaurants, stylish bars and boutique shops are all within easy walking distance, together with the beautiful open spaces of Jesmond Dene, providing idyllic walks and recreational opportunities. The apartment is also ideally positioned for Newcastle city centre, the universities and major hospitals, whilst Jesmond and West Jesmond Metro stations offer excellent transport links throughout the city and beyond, making this a particularly desirable location for professionals and commuters. Internally, the apartment offers exceptionally spacious accommodation, with high ceilings and large windows creating an abundance of natural light and enhancing the sense of grandeur throughout. At the heart of the home is an impressive open-plan lounge and kitchen, providing the perfect space for both relaxing and entertaining. The accommodation further comprises two generously proportioned bedrooms, with the principal bedroom benefiting from its own en-suite shower room, in addition to a well-appointed family bathroom. Externally, the property is approached via gated access into beautifully maintained communal grounds. Set behind established wall boundaries, the attractive communal gardens are predominantly laid to lawn and complemented by mature trees and established planting, creating a peaceful setting that belies the property's highly central location. With the added benefit of a tenant currently in situ, this outstanding apartment represents an excellent turnkey investment opportunity, whilst its spacious accommodation, period charm and prestigious Jesmond location ensure enduring appeal for future owner-occupiers. Combining character, generous proportions and one of Newcastle's most sought-after addresses, early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate everything this exceptional apartment has to offer.

COMMUNAL ENTRANCE The property is accessed via an attractive communal entrance, providing a welcoming approach to this impressive converted residence. Well maintained and secure, the entrance reflects the character and charm of the building whilst offering access to the ground floor apartment. Creating an excellent first impression, the communal areas are presented to a good standard and complement the property's prestigious setting on one of Jesmond's most desirable residential addresses.

ENTRANCE HALLWAY A welcoming and well-proportioned entrance hallway provides access to all of the principal accommodation, creating an excellent flow throughout the apartment. Reflecting the generous proportions synonymous with this impressive period conversion, the hallway sets the tone for the spacious and well-presented accommodation beyond. Serving as the central hub of the home, the hallway enhances the sense of space and character found throughout the apartment, whilst providing a warm and inviting first impression.

OPEN PLAN LOUNGE / KITCHEN Undoubtedly the heart of this impressive apartment, the superb open-plan lounge and kitchen offers an exceptional sense of space, enhanced by the property's impressive high ceilings and elegant proportions. Beautifully designed for modern living, this sociable living space seamlessly combines character with contemporary style, making it ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. The lounge enjoys a magnificent large bay window overlooking the beautifully maintained communal gardens, allowing an abundance of natural light to flood the room whilst providing a delightful outlook. Attractive wood flooring adds warmth and character, complementing the bright and airy feel of this generously proportioned reception space. There is ample room to accommodate a range of lounge furniture, creating a comfortable and inviting environment. Flowing effortlessly from the lounge, the well-appointed kitchen is fitted with a comprehensive range of modern base and wall units, complemented by glass display cabinets and laminate work surfaces, providing both style and practicality. An inset sink unit with drainer is incorporated within the work surface, whilst integrated appliances include an oven, hob with a stainless steel chimney-style extractor over, microwave and a range of further integrated appliances, creating a sleek and functional cooking space. Tiled flooring completes the kitchen area, providing a practical and contemporary finish. The open-plan design enhances the apartment's spacious feel, creating a superb lifestyle space that perfectly suits modern-day living whilst retaining the elegance and character expected from such a prestigious Jesmond conversion.

BEDROOM ONE The impressive principal bedroom is a generously proportioned double room, offering a peaceful and comfortable retreat whilst continuing the spacious feel found throughout the apartment. Beautifully presented and flooded with natural light from a UPVC-framed double-glazed window, the room provides ample space for a comprehensive range of bedroom furniture, creating a stylish and relaxing environment. Further benefits include an electric heater for year-round comfort, together with the added luxury of direct access to the private en-suite shower room. Spacious, bright and well appointed, the principal bedroom perfectly complements the high standard of accommodation offered throughout this elegant Jesmond apartment.

EN SUITE

The en-suite shower room is appointed with a contemporary white suite, providing a practical addition to the principal bedroom. The suite comprises a shower enclosure with a mains-fed shower, a wash hand basin neatly set within a vanity unit offering useful storage, and a low-level WC. Finished with tiled walls for a sleek and easy-to-maintain appearance, the room also benefits from a heater, ensuring year-round comfort. The en-suite complements the quality and finish found across this impressive converted apartment, adding further appeal to the spacious principal bedroom.

BEDROOM TWO A further generously proportioned double bedroom, offering flexible accommodation that is equally well suited as a guest bedroom, home office or additional principal bedroom. The room provides ample space for a range of bedroom furniture, creating a bright and comfortable setting to suit a variety of lifestyles. A particular feature of this room is the UPVC-framed double-glazed door, which provides direct access to a private rear courtyard area, offering a pleasant outdoor aspect and an excellent extension of the living space. An electric wall-mounted heater provides warmth and comfort, completing this well-presented and versatile second bedroom.

FAMILY

BATHROOM The family bathroom is appointed with a white suite, perfectly complementing the quality and style found throughout this impressive apartment. Designed with both comfort and practicality in mind, the suite comprises a panelled bath with a mains-fed shower over, providing the flexibility of both a relaxing bath and a refreshing shower. A wash hand basin is neatly set within a modern vanity storage unit, offering useful cupboard space whilst maintaining a sleek and uncluttered appearance, with a low-level WC completing the suite. The room is finished with fully tiled walls and coordinating tiled flooring, creating a stylish and easy-to-maintain environment. An electric heater provides year-round comfort, completing this well-presented bathroom, which continues the high standard of accommodation offered throughout this elegant Jesmond home.

EXTERNALLY Externally, the property is set within beautifully maintained communal grounds, enhancing the character and appeal of this impressive period conversion. Accessed via secure gated entrances, the development enjoys a peaceful and private setting, set back from the prestigious Osborne Road. The attractive communal gardens are predominantly laid to lawn and complemented by an abundance of mature trees and established planting, creating a tranquil environment for residents to enjoy throughout the year. Enclosed by a combination of traditional walls and fencing, the grounds offer both privacy and security whilst providing an attractive approach to the apartment. These delightful communal gardens perfectly complement the elegance of the building and further enhance the appeal of this exceptional home, ideally positioned within one of Jesmond's most sought-after residential addresses.
